qualification_gap.cause: Existing actual-engine reader answers every state_getReadProof request with original.ProofNodesHex and refuses other methods. It therefore does not demonstrate incremental child namespace, range end, odd nibble, or unread write-sibling proof production.

fixture_contract: Public capture_historical_directory_feed_json starts with an empty owned directory and native observation profile.
Broker decodes and binds every frame schema, sequence, request digest, parent hash and root; reconstructs each high-nibble-padded probe.
Top requests use pinned prove_read_on_trie_backend; child requests must name the exact full child namespace and use prove_child_read_on_trie_backend.
Only the exact requested Blake2-256 node is published from that SDK-generated proof before each acknowledgement; the complete snapshot is never an answer fallback.
Parent and child roots come from independent complete-map builders. Successful exported jobs replay again through strict proof consumption.
Deletion must fetch an unread sibling not present in the deleted-key read proof, for both top and child tries.
Top and child complete range deletion asserts exact SDK removal counts and at least one actual odd-nibble request.
Faults acknowledge but omit an actual iterator/root node while the declared child root is forged back to the parent root; sticky accessor cause must prevent a report.
Foreign request acknowledgement refuses; exact restart over retained content-addressed bytes completes the original request.

Keep existing public Go broker/actual-engine/cancellation/restart roots; in-process Rust streams do not qualify FIFO inheritance, supervisor deadlines or durable cursor publication.
